YAMPP - Windows tester snapshot, 20 September 2026

Extract the whole ZIP. Run Setup.cmd with your own Melee NTSC-U 1.02
ISO/GCM/RVZ/WIA, then Play YAMPP.cmd. Normal launch plays the opening FMV, then the title. A/Start skips the movie.
Melee Workshop.cmd opens the included editor.
No disc data, installed mods, saves or personal configuration are bundled.

New: selective Akaneia fighters/stages/music from official GitHub,
Mod Manager enable/disable without replacing the application window,
consented download/rejoin, Online rematches, improved four-player rendering,
Saria's Song label, corrected ReDead palettes and Melee-inspired YAMPP branding.

Profile pictures stay LOCAL in this snapshot.
Both Online players need this exact build and matching aspect ratio.
FD 1.0.3 (brown boots in all palettes) is a separate Mod Browser download.

Read docs/tester-build.md for controls, evidence and known limits.
Complete Adventure progression, physical GameCube adapter behavior and
actual Linux gameplay remain unverified.
This is a tester snapshot, not the final public release.

Audio update: fixes compressed-audio block-boundary corruption in Akaneia music.
GameCube and Green Hill were checked; long loading stalls can still cause brief gaps.
